```{r project-paths, include=FALSE}
project_root <- normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)

repeat {
  if (all(dir.exists(file.path(project_root, c("2-Data", "5-Analysis"))))) {
    break
  }

  parent <- dirname(project_root)
  if (identical(parent, project_root)) {
    stop("Open the Xilei-Living-cover-crop project before knitting.")
  }
  project_root <- parent
}

folders <- list.dirs(project_root, recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)
wrangling_dir <- folders[grepl("wrangling$", basename(folders), ignore.case = TRUE)]

if (length(wrangling_dir) != 1L) {
  stop("Expected one Wrangling folder directly inside the project.")
}

raw_dir <- file.path(project_root, "2-Data", "Raw")
clean_dir <- file.path(wrangling_dir, "Clean")
```

```{r wrangling-setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readxl)

audit_dir <- file.path(wrangling_dir, "Audit")
dir.create(clean_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(audit_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write_table <- function(x, folder, name) {
  utils::write.csv(
    x, file.path(folder, paste0(name, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE, na = ""
  )
}

save_clean <- function(x, name) write_table(x, clean_dir, name)
save_audit <- function(x, name) write_table(x, audit_dir, name)

weed_file <- file.path(raw_dir, "Vegetation survey - broccoli harvest.xlsx")
yield_file <- file.path(raw_dir, "Broccoli harvest.xlsx")

for (path in c(weed_file, yield_file)) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("Missing GitHub workbook in 2-Data/Raw: ", path)
}

save_audit(
  data.frame(
    workbook = basename(c(weed_file, yield_file)),
    md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(c(weed_file, yield_file)))
  ),
  "Input_workbooks"
)
```

```{r read-weed-harvest}
weed_raw <- read_excel(
  weed_file,
  sheet = "2026",
  range = cell_cols("A:J"),
  col_types = c(
    "date", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric", "numeric",
    "text", "text", "numeric", "numeric", "date"
  )
)

expected_headers <- c(
  "Biomass collection date", "Weeks after transplanting", "Block",
  "Treatment", "Quadrat", "Relative location to Broccoli: in row or in cover crop",
  "Species", "Biomass weight without bags, scale tared (gram)",
  "Quadrat size (m2)", "Weight date"
)
stopifnot(identical(names(weed_raw), expected_headers))

names(weed_raw) <- c(
  "collection_date", "weeks_after_transplanting", "block", "treatment",
  "quadrat", "source_location", "source_species", "source_weight_g",
  "source_area_m2", "weighing_date"
)

weed_raw$excel_row <- seq_len(nrow(weed_raw)) + 1L
weed_raw <- weed_raw |>
  filter(if_any(-excel_row, ~ !is.na(.x)))

if (nrow(weed_raw) != 417L) {
  stop("Use the 417-record GitHub version of the 2026 vegetation workbook.")
}

duplicate_row <- duplicated(weed_raw[setdiff(names(weed_raw), "excel_row")])
save_audit(weed_raw[duplicate_row, ], "Weed_exact_duplicates")
if (any(duplicate_row)) stop("Review Weed_exact_duplicates.csv.")

sampling_locations <- c("Broccoli" = "Intrarow", "Cover crop" = "Interrow",
                        "Intrarow" = "Intrarow", "Interrow" = "Interrow")
records <- weed_raw |>
  mutate(
    collection_date = as.Date(collection_date),
    weighing_date = as.Date(weighing_date),
    location = if_else(treatment == 1, "Interrow",
                       unname(sampling_locations[trimws(source_location)])),
    species = toupper(trimws(gsub("[[:space:]]+", " ", source_species))),
    species = recode(
      species,
      "UNKNOWNN MONOCOTS" = "UNKNOWN MONOCOTS",
      "UNKNOWNN DICOTS" = "UNKNOWN DICOTS"
    ),
    weight_g = source_weight_g,
    area_m2 = if_else(location == "Intrarow", 0.28, 0.16),
    cutting_height_cm = if_else(location == "Intrarow", 0, 8),
    stratum = location,
    sample_id = paste0("B", block, "_T", treatment, "_", stratum, "_Q", quadrat)
  )

stopifnot(
  all(records$block %in% 1:4),
  all(records$treatment %in% 1:4),
  all(records$quadrat %in% 1:4),
  all(records$location %in% c("Intrarow", "Interrow")),
  !anyNA(records$collection_date),
  all(!is.na(records$species) & nzchar(records$species)),
  all(is.finite(records$weight_g) & records$weight_g >= 0)
)
```

```{r correct-weight-and-classify}
target <- which(
  records$collection_date == as.Date("2026-09-11") &
  records$block == 4 & records$treatment == 4 &
  records$location == "Interrow" & records$quadrat == 2 &
  records$species == "UNKNOWN MONOCOTS"
)

stopifnot(length(target) == 1L)
portions_g <- c(1.34, 0.07)
combined_g <- sum(portions_g)

if (!any(abs(records$source_weight_g[target] - c(portions_g, combined_g)) < 1e-8)) {
  stop("Review the source weight for B4/T4 interrow Q2 UNKNOWN MONOCOTS.")
}
records$weight_g[target] <- combined_g

save_audit(
  records[target, ] |>
    select(excel_row, collection_date, weighing_date, sample_id, species,
           source_weight_g, weight_g),
  "Split_weighing_correction"
)

weed_codes <- c(
  "AMARE", "ARTVU", "CAPBP", "CHEAL", "DIGIS", "DIGSA", "ECHCG",
  "GASCI", "LACSE", "MALNE", "MEDLU", "OXASD", "OXAST", "PLANA",
  "POLLA", "POLPE", "POROL", "SETSP", "SETPU", "SETVI", "TRFRE"
)
berseem_codes <- c("TRFAL", "BERSEEM", "BERSEEM CLOVER", "TRIFOLIUM ALEXANDRINUM")
rye_codes <- c("RYE", "CEREAL RYE", "SECALE CEREALE", "SECCE")
volunteer_codes <- c("CLOVER", "VOLUNTEER CLOVER")

records <- records |>
  mutate(
    is_unknown_weed = grepl("^UNKNOWN($| )", species),
    component = case_when(
      species %in% c(berseem_codes, rye_codes) ~ "Cover crop",
      species %in% volunteer_codes ~ "Volunteer",
      species %in% weed_codes | is_unknown_weed ~ "Weed",
      TRUE ~ "Unmapped"
    ),
    species_label = case_when(
      species %in% berseem_codes ~ "Berseem clover",
      species %in% rye_codes ~ "Cereal rye",
      species %in% volunteer_codes ~ "Volunteer clover",
      TRUE ~ species
    )
  )

unmapped <- filter(records, component == "Unmapped")
save_audit(unmapped, "Unmapped_species")
if (nrow(unmapped)) stop("Review Unmapped_species.csv.")

save_audit(
  distinct(records, source_species, species, species_label, component),
  "Species_classification"
)
save_audit(
  filter(records, is.na(source_area_m2) | abs(source_area_m2 - area_m2) > 1e-8 |
           !coalesce(unname(sampling_locations[trimws(source_location)]) == location, FALSE)),
  "Sampling_corrections"
)
save_audit(filter(records, is_unknown_weed), "Unknown_weed_records")
```

```{r validate-quadrats}
samples <- records |>
  distinct(sample_id, block, treatment, location, stratum, quadrat,
           area_m2, cutting_height_cm, collection_date)

expected <- bind_rows(
  expand_grid(block = 1:4, treatment = 1L, location = "Interrow", quadrat = 1:4),
  expand_grid(block = 1:4, treatment = 2:4,
              location = c("Intrarow", "Interrow"), quadrat = 1:2)
)

sample_keys <- c("block", "treatment", "location", "quadrat")
missing_samples <- anti_join(expected, samples, by = sample_keys)
extra_samples <- anti_join(samples, expected, by = sample_keys)

save_audit(missing_samples, "Missing_quadrats")
save_audit(extra_samples, "Unexpected_quadrats")

stopifnot(
  nrow(samples) == 64L,
  !anyDuplicated(samples$sample_id),
  nrow(missing_samples) == 0L,
  nrow(extra_samples) == 0L,
  !anyDuplicated(records[c("sample_id", "species")])
)

save_clean(records, "clean_T1_T4_records")
save_clean(samples, "Sample_metadata")
```

```{r prepare-biomass-tables}
quadrat_biomass <- records |>
  group_by(sample_id, block, treatment, location, quadrat) |>
  summarise(
    area_m2 = first(area_m2),
    identified_weed_g = sum(weight_g[component == "Weed" & !is_unknown_weed]),
    unknown_weed_g = sum(weight_g[component == "Weed" & is_unknown_weed]),
    volunteer_g = sum(weight_g[component == "Volunteer"]),
    n_cover_crop_records = sum(component == "Cover crop"),
    recorded_cover_crop_g = if (any(component == "Cover crop")) {
      sum(weight_g[component == "Cover crop"])
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    recorded_total_g = sum(weight_g),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    identified_weed_g_m2 = identified_weed_g / area_m2,
    unknown_weed_g_m2 = unknown_weed_g / area_m2,
    volunteer_g_m2 = volunteer_g / area_m2,
    weed_g_m2 = (identified_weed_g + unknown_weed_g) / area_m2,
    recorded_cover_crop_g_m2 = recorded_cover_crop_g / area_m2,
    recorded_total_g_m2 = recorded_total_g / area_m2
  )

plot_biomass <- quadrat_biomass |>
  group_by(block, treatment, location) |>
  summarise(
    n_quadrats = n(),
    across(c(identified_weed_g_m2, unknown_weed_g_m2, volunteer_g_m2,
             weed_g_m2, recorded_total_g_m2), mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(block = paste0("B", block), treatment = paste0("T", treatment))

stopifnot(
  nrow(plot_biomass) == 28L,
  all(plot_biomass$n_quadrats == ifelse(plot_biomass$treatment == "T1", 4L, 2L))
)

cc_records <- records |>
  filter(component == "Cover crop") |>
  group_by(block, treatment, location, quadrat, species_label) |>
  summarise(Area_m2 = first(area_m2), Weight_g = sum(weight_g), .groups = "drop") |>
  transmute(
    Block = paste0("B", block), Treatment = paste0("T", treatment),
    Location = location, Quadrat = quadrat, Species = species_label,
    Area_m2, Weight_g, Biomass_g_m2 = Weight_g / Area_m2
  )

save_clean(quadrat_biomass, "quadrat_biomass_components")
save_clean(plot_biomass, "plot_biomass_components")
save_clean(cc_records, "recorded_cover_crop_biomass")
```

```{r prepare-community-categories}
community_samples <- samples |>
  transmute(
    Sample_ID = sample_id,
    Block = paste0("B", block), Treatment = paste0("T", treatment),
    Quadrat = quadrat,
    Location = location,
    Stratum = stratum, Area_m2 = area_m2,
    Cutting_height_cm = cutting_height_cm, Collection_date = collection_date
  )

category_summary <- records |>
  group_by(Broad_category = component) |>
  summarise(Biomass_g = sum(weight_g), Records = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(Percent_of_recorded_mass = 100 * Biomass_g / sum(Biomass_g))

observed_categories <- records |>
  group_by(Sample_ID = sample_id, Broad_category = component) |>
  summarise(Biomass_g = sum(weight_g), .groups = "drop")

category_quadrats <- expand_grid(
  Sample_ID = community_samples$Sample_ID,
  Broad_category = c("Volunteer", "Weed", "Cover crop")
) |>
  left_join(observed_categories, by = c("Sample_ID", "Broad_category")) |>
  mutate(Biomass_g = replace_na(Biomass_g, 0)) |>
  left_join(community_samples, by = "Sample_ID") |>
  mutate(Biomass_g_m2 = Biomass_g / Area_m2)

category_plots <- category_quadrats |>
  group_by(Block, Treatment, Stratum, Broad_category) |>
  summarise(
    N_quadrats = n(),
    Mean_quadrat_biomass_g = mean(Biomass_g),
    Mean_biomass_g_m2 = mean(Biomass_g_m2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

category_treatments <- category_plots |>
  group_by(Treatment, Stratum, Broad_category) |>
  summarise(
    N_plots = n(),
    SD_quadrat_biomass_g = sd(Mean_quadrat_biomass_g),
    SE_quadrat_biomass_g = SD_quadrat_biomass_g / sqrt(N_plots),
    SD_biomass_g_m2 = sd(Mean_biomass_g_m2),
    SE_biomass_g_m2 = SD_biomass_g_m2 / sqrt(N_plots),
    Mean_quadrat_biomass_g = mean(Mean_quadrat_biomass_g),
    Mean_biomass_g_m2 = mean(Mean_biomass_g_m2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(category_quadrats) == 192L,
  all(category_treatments$N_plots == 4L),
  abs(sum(category_quadrats$Biomass_g) - sum(records$weight_g)) < 1e-8
)

save_clean(category_summary, "Category_mass_summary")
save_clean(category_quadrats, "Category_biomass_by_quadrat")
save_clean(category_plots, "Category_biomass_plot_means")
save_clean(category_treatments, "Category_biomass_treatment_summary")
```

```{r prepare-diversity-indices}
weed_mass <- records |>
  filter(component == "Weed") |>
  group_by(Sample_ID = sample_id, Species = species, is_unknown_weed) |>
  summarise(mass_g = sum(weight_g), .groups = "drop")

index_input <- bind_rows(
  mutate(weed_mass, Analysis = "Total weeds"),
  weed_mass |>
    filter(!is_unknown_weed) |>
    mutate(Analysis = "Identified weed codes")
) |>
  filter(mass_g > 0)

sample_totals <- quadrat_biomass |>
  transmute(
    Sample_ID = sample_id,
    Recorded_mass_g = recorded_total_g,
    Total_weed_mass_g = identified_weed_g + unknown_weed_g
  )

quadrat_indices <- index_input |>
  group_by(Sample_ID, Analysis) |>
  summarise(
    Richness = n(),
    Included_mass_g = sum(mass_g),
    Inverse_Simpson = 1 / sum((mass_g / sum(mass_g))^2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(Simpson_evenness = Inverse_Simpson / Richness) |>
  left_join(community_samples, by = "Sample_ID") |>
  left_join(sample_totals, by = "Sample_ID") |>
  mutate(Omitted_fraction_of_total_weed_mass = 1 - Included_mass_g / Total_weed_mass_g)

stopifnot(
  nrow(quadrat_indices) == 2L * nrow(community_samples),
  all(quadrat_indices$Inverse_Simpson >= 1 - 1e-8),
  all(quadrat_indices$Inverse_Simpson <= quadrat_indices$Richness + 1e-8),
  all(quadrat_indices$Simpson_evenness <= 1 + 1e-8)
)

plot_indices <- quadrat_indices |>
  group_by(Analysis, Block, Treatment, Stratum) |>
  summarise(
    N_quadrats = n(),
    across(c(Richness, Inverse_Simpson, Simpson_evenness), mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stopifnot(nrow(plot_indices) == 56L)
save_clean(quadrat_indices, "Quadrat_indices")
save_clean(plot_indices, "Plot_mean_indices")
```

```{r prepare-species-composition}
species_quadrats <- expand_grid(
  Sample_ID = community_samples$Sample_ID,
  Species = sort(unique(weed_mass$Species))
) |>
  left_join(select(weed_mass, Sample_ID, Species, mass_g),
            by = c("Sample_ID", "Species")) |>
  mutate(Biomass_g = replace_na(mass_g, 0)) |>
  select(-mass_g) |>
  left_join(community_samples, by = "Sample_ID") |>
  mutate(Biomass_g_m2 = Biomass_g / Area_m2)

species_plots <- species_quadrats |>
  group_by(Block, Treatment, Stratum, Species) |>
  summarise(Biomass_g_m2 = mean(Biomass_g_m2), .groups = "drop")

species_means <- species_plots |>
  group_by(Treatment, Stratum, Species) |>
  summarise(Mean_biomass_g_m2 = mean(Biomass_g_m2), .groups = "drop")

crosscheck <- species_quadrats |>
  group_by(Sample_ID) |>
  summarise(from_species = sum(Biomass_g_m2), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(
    transmute(quadrat_biomass, Sample_ID = sample_id, from_biomass = weed_g_m2),
    by = "Sample_ID"
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(crosscheck) == 64L,
  all(abs(crosscheck$from_species - crosscheck$from_biomass) < 1e-8)
)

save_clean(species_quadrats, "Species_composition_quadrats")
save_clean(species_plots, "Species_composition_plot_means")
save_clean(species_means, "Species_composition_all_taxa")
save_audit(crosscheck, "Biomass_diversity_crosscheck")
```

```{r read-and-clean-broccoli-heads}
read_heads <- function(sheet, identifiers) {
  columns <- c(
    "harvest_date", identifiers, "row_position", "fresh_weight_g",
    "grade", "appearance_note", "hollow_core", "marketable"
  )

  x <- read_excel(
    yield_file, sheet = sheet,
    range = cell_cols(c(1L, length(columns))),
    col_types = c("date", rep("text", length(columns) - 1L))
  )
  names(x) <- columns
  x$excel_row <- seq_len(nrow(x)) + 1L

  x |>
    mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ na_if(trimws(.x), ""))) |>
    filter(if_any(all_of(columns), ~ !is.na(.x))) |>
    mutate(
      harvest_date = as.Date(harvest_date),
      across(all_of(identifiers), toupper),
      row_position = recode(
        toupper(row_position), E = "EAST", W = "WEST",
        M = "MIDDLE", CENTER = "MIDDLE", CENTRE = "MIDDLE"
      ),
      fresh_weight_g = as.numeric(fresh_weight_g),
      field_flag = toupper(marketable),
      marketable = field_flag
    )
}

living <- read_heads("living mulch", c("block", "treatment"))
plastic <- read_heads("plastic mulch", "section")

for (x in list(living, plastic)) {
  stopifnot(
    !anyNA(x$harvest_date),
    all(is.finite(x$fresh_weight_g) & x$fresh_weight_g > 0),
    all(x$grade %in% as.character(1:7)),
    all(is.na(x$field_flag) | x$field_flag %in% c("Y", "N"))
  )
}

stopifnot(
  all(living$block %in% paste0("B", 1:4)),
  all(living$treatment %in% paste0("T", 1:4)),
  all(living$row_position %in% c("EAST", "MIDDLE", "WEST")),
  all(plastic$section %in% as.character(1:4)),
  all(plastic$row_position %in% c("EAST", "WEST"))
)

confirmed_head <- which(
  plastic$harvest_date == as.Date("2026-10-22") &
  plastic$section == "2" & plastic$row_position == "WEST" &
  plastic$fresh_weight_g == 241 & plastic$grade == "3"
)
stopifnot(length(confirmed_head) == 1L)
stopifnot(is.na(plastic$field_flag[confirmed_head]) ||
            plastic$field_flag[confirmed_head] == "Y")
plastic$marketable[confirmed_head] <- "Y"

marketable_head <- function(grade, flag) {
  grade %in% c("3", "4", "5") & flag %in% "Y"
}

living <- living |>
  mutate(
    in_middle_strip = treatment %in% c("T2", "T3", "T4") & row_position == "MIDDLE",
    in_yield = in_middle_strip & marketable_head(grade, marketable)
  )

plastic <- plastic |>
  mutate(in_yield = marketable_head(grade, marketable))

living_heads <- filter(living, in_middle_strip)

save_audit(plastic[confirmed_head, ], "Plastic_confirmed_head")
save_clean(living, "Living_mulch_clean_heads")
save_clean(plastic, "Plastic_mulch_clean_heads")
```

```{r prepare-yield-tables}
whole_plot_m2 <- 4.0 * 6.7
living_strip_area_m2 <- whole_plot_m2 / 3
plastic_section_area_m2 <- 2 * whole_plot_m2 / 3

summarise_yield <- function(head_data, keys, area) {
  head_data |>
    group_by(across(all_of(keys))) |>
    summarise(
      yield_kg = sum(fresh_weight_g[in_yield]) / 1000,
      heads = sum(in_yield),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    mutate(
      mean_head_g = if_else(heads > 0, yield_kg * 1000 / heads, NA_real_),
      harvest_area_m2 = area,
      yield_kg_ha = yield_kg / harvest_area_m2 * 10000
    )
}

yield_plots <- summarise_yield(
  living_heads, c("block", "treatment"), living_strip_area_m2
)

plastic_beds <- summarise_yield(
  plastic, c("section", "row_position"), plastic_section_area_m2
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(yield_plots) == 12L,
  all(table(yield_plots$block, yield_plots$treatment) == 1L),
  nrow(plastic_beds) == 8L,
  all(table(plastic_beds$section, plastic_beds$row_position) == 1L)
)

plastic_reference <- plastic_beds |>
  summarise(
    bed_sections = n(), heads = sum(heads),
    total_yield_kg = sum(yield_kg), total_area_m2 = sum(harvest_area_m2)
  ) |>
  mutate(
    mean_head_g = if_else(heads > 0, total_yield_kg * 1000 / heads, NA_real_),
    yield_kg_ha = total_yield_kg / total_area_m2 * 10000
  )

middle_counts <- living_heads |>
  group_by(treatment) |>
  summarise(weighed = n(), marketable = sum(in_yield), .groups = "drop")

save_clean(yield_plots, "Plot_yield")
save_clean(plastic_beds, "Plastic_mulch_bed_yield")
save_clean(plastic_reference, "Plastic_mulch_reference")
save_clean(middle_counts, "Yield_middle_strip_counts")
```
